description_en: Enables or disables the audit log feature and delivers audit logs to buckets
description_zh: 开通或关闭审计日志、配置审计日志投递Bucket
kebab_example: aliyun hsm config-audit-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --audit-oss-bucket hsm-log --audit-action enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigAuditLog

parameters.help_en: The bucket to which audit logs are delivered
parameters.name: audit_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the audit log feature. Valid values:

- enable

- disable
parameters.help_zh:
审计日志开通状态。
- enable：启用 
- disable：关闭
parameters.name: audit_action
